dog.description_text:
Meet Mariah – Your Quiet, Gentle Companion 🐾
Age: 2 years old, 8 lbs
Breed: Tabby
Litter Box Trained: Yes ✅

Mariah is a sweet and shy little lady looking for a calm, loving forever home. She's independent and low-maintenance — happy to simply share your space without demanding too much attention. While she’s not a cuddlebug, she enjoys being near her people and watching the world go by from a cozy spot.

She loves the company of other cats and would thrive in a home with a feline friend. Mariah enjoys gentle play and gets along well with other respectful cats. Her shy nature means she may take a little time to warm up, but once she feels safe, she blossoms into a peaceful presence in your home.

If you’re looking for a quiet, mellow companion who will coexist peacefully and bring a calming energy to your life — Mariah may be the perfect match.

If you would like to give this wonderful cat a home, please email rescue@pupstarzrescue.org or visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
